item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Stats 3.1.1
item.description:
System monitor for the menu bar

Stats is a system monitoring tool that lives in the macOS menu bar and shows live metrics: battery level, Bluetooth device connections, CPU frequency (Intel only), CPU usage, disk usage, fan speed, GPU usage, memory, network usage, and temperature, voltage and power from various sensors. It supports many interface languages, several menu bar styles (bar chart, pie chart, line graph, numbers), customizable metrics, and alerts that play a sound or send a notification when a threshold is reached.

item.title: WinMux 0.5.7
item.description:
Mac Project Workspace Management

WinMux is a window management tool for macOS that organizes the desktop using project groups, workspaces, and an interactive sidebar. It is ideal for users who work with multiple projects, browser windows, and reference materials simultaneously. Each project has its own set of workspaces, and the sidebar visually displays the distribution of windows. It supports dragging and dropping windows between the current workspace and the sidebar, as well as rearranging windows and tab groups across workspaces. By default, it automatically tiles newly discovered windows, but it can also retain the original size and position of windows when used in conjunction with manual layout commands. When dragging the title bar, continuous horizontal shaking can also switch between floating and tiled states. Tab groups allow multiple windows to share the same desktop area, and support switching by clicking, sorting by dragging, and navigation using shortcut keys. Multiple monitors share items and workspace statuses, and each screen can independently select different workspaces. Users can adjust window spacing, sidebar expansion and auto-hide behavior, clock display, and interface color schemes, and use the native Liquid Glass effect on macOS 26 and later. The software also supports single modifier key shortcuts, importing AeroSpace keybindings on first launch, and checking for updates via GitHub Releases.

item.title: TextLab 6.2
item.description:
Mac Text Cleaner

TextLab is a text processing tool for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that integrates more than sixty conversion and editing operations for developers, writers, content editors, and users who need to organize their text. After pasting the text, you can convert the case and code naming formatting, clear extra spaces, blank lines, duplicate content and invisible characters, and view the number of words, lines, reading time and other statistical information in real time. The software supports JSON, XML, HTML, and YAML format finishing, CSV and JSON interchange, as well as Base64, URL, and hex encoding and decoding, with regular search replacement, content extraction, and real-time matching tests to facilitate processing structured data. Users can also compare line-by-line and word-level differences between two texts, drag to rearrange paragraphs or sentences, transform Markdown, remove link-tracking parameters, and save multi-step actions as repeatable workflows. Shortcuts and shared extensions make it easy to connect daily operations, and iCloud synchronizes workflows and editing preferences. Text conversion is performed locally on the device without the need to register an account; macOS 14.0 or later is required on the Mac side.

item.title: Canopy v2 1.2.2
item.description:
macOS Dynamic Island Enhancer

Canopy 2 is a dynamic Dynamic Island enhancement tool for macOS that transforms the Mac's notch area or the space at the top of the screen into an information display and media control center, allowing notifications, music, videos, device status, and weather information to be presented in a more natural way. It supports the display of AirPods battery level and connection status, and allows you to view playback information, album covers, playback controls, and progress sliders for Spotify and Apple Music in the Dynamic Island. It can also handle the playback status of video platforms such as Netflix and Twitch. The software also provides time-synchronized lock screen lyrics, charging animations, low battery reminders, and real-time weather information. It is compatible with external monitors and Macs without a notch design, making it suitable for use with various combinations of desktops and devices. Canopy 2 focuses on being lightweight and efficient, minimizing resource usage and not interfering with daily workflows. A single license can activate up to three Macs, and users can manage, remove, or edit verified devices at any time, making notification browsing, media operations, and system status viewing more centralized, intuitive, and visually expressive.

item.title: Downie 4 4.13.5
item.description:
Powerful web video downloader

Downie is a powerful video downloader that makes it easy to download videos from the internet and supports over 1000 websites including YouTube, Bilibili and Vimeo. Downie supports 4K video downloading with automatic post-processing to convert videos to MP4 format for iPhone or iPad, or to extract audio tracks only. Downie also provides history synchronization, fast support, and frequent updates to ensure users are always able to download the latest content. Downie also supports multilingual localization, and users are welcome to provide translations for a free license. Downie's user interface is simple and easy to use, and users can quickly download videos by simply pasting a link, which greatly improves download efficiency. Whether you're getting short videos or saving audio, Downie is for you. Post-processing: Automatically convert videos to MP4 format or extract only audio tracks for easy playback on your iPhone or iPad. Quick Support: For email inquiries from users, usually respond within 24 hours and add the website requesting support in the next update.

item.title: Thumbwise 1.0.41
item.description:
Organize iPhone Home Screen on Mac

Thumbwise is a tool for organizing the iPhone Home Screen on a Mac. It reads the phone's layout via a USB cable, allowing you to adjust the positions of apps, folders, and widgets on your computer, and then apply the confirmed layout directly to your iPhone. It provides an App Bank temporary storage area, making it easy to temporarily remove apps when redesigning pages; Moving a single app does not disrupt the positions of other apps, and apps that were originally kept only in the App Library will remain there. Based on the available app usage data from the past 30 days, the software can estimate the number of swipes between Home Screen pages and optimize the layout through different organization modes to reduce the number of page turns when searching for frequently used apps. With the MCP tool, you can also connect to compatible AI assistants, which, after authorization, will arrange icons according to criteria such as color. The changes will be applied only after you review the results. The home screen layout and app activity data are stored locally, with no need to register an account or jailbreak the device.

item.title: CoolDock 2.2.5-beta.1
item.description:
Mac Dock Enhancement Tool

CoolDock is an intelligent second Dock tool for macOS Sonoma and higher, which does not replace the original Dock of the system, but provides a separate docking bar next to it that can carry real-time components, shortcuts, application entrances, and daily information. Users can centralize music playback, weather, calendar events, reminders, to-dos, pomodoros, system status, searches, clipboards, screenshots, file shelves, download directories, quick switches, and more in one beautiful dynamic dock, reducing the frequency of switching between multiple apps. The software emphasizes local and privacy priorities, and only requests permissions such as calendars, reminders, photos, microphones, accessibility, or automation when required by the relevant features. It also supports app and folder fixing, multiple Dock configurations, floating layouts, resizing and appearance adjustments, wallpaper decoration, and modern Mac workflows with external displays, allowing users to build a more efficient and personalized desktop action center according to their own habits.

item.title: Trace 2.1.0
item.description:
Mac Storage Visualization Analysis Tool

Trace is a storage inspection and uninstallation tool for macOS that focuses on making the system's hard-to-understand occupied space clearly visible. It can analyze the composition of disk space, further breaking down System Data into more specific items such as caches, logs, containers, and snapshots, and providing explanations and evidence for each item to let users know what is taking up the space. For applications, it can view the app itself and related data, shared files, residual items, and risk levels, helping users to clean up and uninstall with a clear basis, rather than blindly deleting them like traditional cleanup tools. The software also supports folder and disk analysis, game library identification, Homebrew package management, default application management, cloud file status viewing, as well as quarantine and undo mechanisms. It balances transparency, security, and controllability, making it suitable for users who want to gain a deeper understanding of and organize their Mac storage. Trace is a macOS storage inspection and uninstallation tool specifically designed to provide a clearer breakdown of system storage usage, application remnants, and various types of file data. It emphasizes explainable, traceable, and controllable cleanup processes, making it suitable for users who want to know "where the space went."

item.title: extraDock 5.2.7-beta.2
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: AppGridMac 1.2.17
item.description:
macOS App Grid Launcher

AppGrid is a Launchpad alternative designed for macOS 26 Tahoe. It restores the classic grid app view for free and supports core features such as importing layouts from the old Launchpad, renaming apps, sorting by page A–Z, adding missing or newly installed apps, and using keyboard shortcuts to quickly open and flip pages. The Pro upgrade unlocks additional features like multi-select drag-and-drop, batch grouping and editing, removing apps from the grid, sorting all pages together, and saving Save/export grid files and more comprehensive custom management tools. Supports exporting/importing layouts for reuse across multiple Macs. System requirements: macOS (Tahoe/Sequoia or later), 4GB of RAM, and a small amount of storage. Developers respond quickly, and user reviews generally praise its reliability, restoration of the familiar Launchpad experience, and suitability for visual management of a large number of apps.

item.title: IPTV Expert 11.8.0
item.description:
IPTV Network Streaming Player

IPTV Expert is the ultimate IPTV player designed for a seamless streaming experience, freeing users from dissatisfaction. It supports all IPTV service providers and media content and is loved by thousands of users. IPTV Expert ensures a seamless viewing experience on the go with easy playlist importing, great automatic categorization, Chromecast support, Electronic Program Guide (EPG), offline viewing, replay functionality, subtitle support, and multi-account management. Its beautiful user interface, series browsing features, and picture-in-picture support further enhance the ease and fun of use, resulting in a high-quality streaming experience. Upgrade your viewing experience with IPTV Expert! Tired of unsatisfactory IPTV players? Meet IPTV Expert, the ultimate IPTV player designed for exceptional performance. Loved and trusted by thousands of users, IPTV Expert supports all IPTV providers and media content for unparalleled viewing pleasure.

item.title: SenPlayer 6.3.1
item.description:
macOS Cloud Storage Video Player

SenPlayer is a powerful multi-platform video player that supports 8K decoding, Blu-ray ISO disc images, and a wide range of audio and video formats, offering exceptional decoding capabilities. It not only supports Emby, Jellyfin, and multiple cloud storage services (such as Alibaba Cloud, Baidu Cloud, and 115 Cloud), but also enables live TV streaming via WebDAV, SMB, FTP, and IPTV. Users can enjoy the convenience of iCloud syncing their viewing history, enabling a seamless playback experience across multiple devices. In addition, SenPlayer offers full support for HDR10 and HLG, ensuring outstanding HDR performance on Apple devices. It is compatible with a wide range of devices, including iPhones, iPads, Apple TVs, and Macs. The app also offers a range of practical features, including file management, video recording, a private space, and security lock, ensuring a convenient and secure viewing experience for users.

item.title: HamHub 1.7.5
item.description:
Mac Net Drive with IPTV Video Player

HamHub – Your personal audio-visual expert is a multi-device home audio-visual management and playback macOS app that unifies cloud drives, media servers, and local/network resources into a single, clear repository that helps users organize scattered video files into a searchable, renewable, and synchronized private film and television center. It supports Alibaba Drive, Baidu Drive, Google Drive, WebDAV, SMB, Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, IPTV, FTP/FTPS and other sources. It can also automatically identify movies, TV series, variety shows and other structures, and intelligently generate covers, details and episodes. The app has a built-in highly compatible player that supports 4K, Dolby Vision, HDR, Dolby Atmos, ISO Blu-ray Disc, multi-track and rich subtitle formats, and provides a picture-in-picture, continuous playback, gesture control, and speed-doubling viewing experience. Collections, viewing progress, and playback records sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV for users who want to efficiently manage their private library.

item.title: Verso 1.0.72
item.description:
Native Lightweight Word Processor

Verso Writer is a native lightweight word processor for macOS that emphasizes fast startup, focused writing, and reliable document compatibility. It opens and saves DOCX, Markdown, RTF, ODT, TXT and other common formats for collaboration between Microsoft Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, GitHub and other workflows. The software provides compact toolbars, elegant page layout, focus mode, paperless mode, a variety of page appearance, table of contents, annotations, revisions, footnotes, header and footer, tables, images, find replacements and word count and other writing and typesetting capabilities. Markdown files can be visually edited and preserved in rich text, and code blocks support syntax highlighting; BibTeX and CSL JSON reference management can generate references in multiple formats. The app is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It does not rely on Electron, web view or cloud account. The interface supports multiple languages. It is suitable for Mac writers who need low burden, privacy-friendly, and full-featured.

item.title: PeakHour 6.2.6
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Network Traffic Monitor

PeakHour: Internet Monitor is a real-time network monitoring tool for macOS that centralizes bandwidth, latency, wireless signals, and connection health to troubleshoot video conferencing issues, slow downloads, network outages, and poor broadband performance. The software displays Mac, router, and carrier-to-Internet connectivity paths through menu bars and visual dashboards, helps determine where performance bottlenecks lie, and enables monitoring of UPnP or SNMP-capable routers, switches, and NAS. Built-in speed measurement combines download speed, upload speed, and rpm responsiveness ratings, and you can also see actual performance against your broadband plan. Wi-Fi analytics identifies weak signals and distractions, while historical charts make it easy to look back at traffic, delays, congestion, and disconnections. Apple Intelligence-based network consultants can rate connections, explain questions and advise in plain English, and require a Mac that supports that capability.

item.title: Netutilus 1.21.2
item.description:
macOS Web Toolkit

Netutilus: Network Utility is a professional network diagnostic tool designed for Mac that integrates 8 classic and powerful network utilities to help users easily troubleshoot network problems, monitor connection status, and perform advanced diagnostics. Netutilus retains all the benefits of the traditional macOS networking tools that users love, while being fully upgraded with a modern interface design and added power. It provides TCP-based ping testing with real-time latency charts and detailed statistics; supports Traceroute and visual Traceroute (Gold Tier) to track packet paths by hop or view routing information on an interactive world map; built-in speed testing to measure downloads, uplinks, latency and jitter using Cloudflare's global network; DNS query supports custom DNS servers, querying A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, PTR and other record types;

item.title: WaterKit 1.1.4
item.description:
Menu bar to view today's water in real time

WaterKit is a drinking water logging and rehydration reminder tool for macOS, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch that helps users establish stable drinking habits through intuitive progress, dynamic characters, and achievement challenges. The software offers 45 drink types to record water, tea, coffee, juice, milk, sports drinks, and soups, and allows you to adjust the order of drinks, customize icon colors, set your favorite cups, and switch between milliliters, ounces, and liters. The system will combine weight, gender, and activity data to recommend daily goals, with 80 notification texts, 5 types of reminder tones, 19 sounds, and time-sharing scenarios to provide more natural prompts at different times. Users can view drinking water and caffeine statistics from the daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly dimensions, and understand long-term performance through monthly heat maps, recent seven-day insights, and percentage habit scores. The software supports Apple health data reading and writing, iCloud real-time synchronization, Siri voice recording, real-time activities, lock screen and desktop widgets, and the Mac menu bar water droplets will also change dynamically with the intake of the day.

item.title: Mercury Weather 3.8.3
item.description:
macOS Weather Reminder Tool

Mercury Weather is a distinctive weather app that is highly regarded by users for its elegant weather charts, detailed daily forecasts, highly accurate rainfall predictions, a sleek and feature-rich menu bar tool, eye-catching widgets, and a comprehensive overview of typical weather patterns. With its comprehensive and user-friendly design, the app provides a comprehensive weather information platform.

item.title: Vitals 1.13.5
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: Multitouch 2.1.2
item.description:
macOS trackpad gesture control enhancement

Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add gestures to macOS, with support for a well-designed trackpad and magic mouse gestures, and a plethora of options for browsers, keyboard shortcuts, and click actions. The software has built-in best-in-class window management features, including Rectangle's keyboard shortcuts, menu items, and drag-and-drop alignment areas. In addition, users can convert a key to a superkey, click with a key, remap a button, or create a shortcut to execute a script. Multitouch supports the use of any trackpad or magic mouse on macOS 10.15 and above, and each license can be activated simultaneously on up to three devices. Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add multi-touch gestures to macOS with a well-designed trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures. The software provides rich operation options, including browser operations, keystrokes, mouse clicks, etc., to help users achieve efficient workflows.

item.title: Alfred 6.0.3
item.description:
Long-standing productivity tool for macOS launchers

Alfred is a native productivity tool for macOS that integrates app launching, file finding, web searching, and daily automation into a simple keyboard search box. By customizing hotkeys and keywords, users can quickly open applications and folders, search browser bookmarks, local contacts, and past queries, and get results sorted in a way that better suits their usage habits. The clipboard history supports searching for and pasting text, images, file paths, and hexadecimal color codes. Automatic expansion of text snippets reduces the need to repeatedly enter frequently used content. With workflows, users can visually connect functional modules and combine multi-step operations. Developers can also use the Alfred UI to build native interfaces and custom layouts. The software also offers file previews, directory browsing, batch file operations, calculations, spell checking, system commands, music control, and terminal integration, and supports theme customization and synchronization of settings across multiple Macs. Some advanced features require Alfred Powerpack.

item.title: Upto 1.4.0-beta.165
item.description:
Mac App Update Manager

Upto is an application and command-line tool update management software for macOS. It automatically detects applications installed on a Mac, checks for updates from the App Store, Sparkle, Homebrew, TestFlight, Setapp, and other sources, and compiles the results into a single list. It can also manage command-line programs installed via tools such as Homebrew, npm, pipx, and uv, allowing users to view and upgrade them without opening the Terminal. Before updating, you can view the source, rating, and natively translated version notes, choose the stable or beta version, skip a version, or temporarily or permanently ignore specific apps. Upto supports batch updates and confirms major version updates. It can also be approved via Touch ID. Downloaded content is verified based on the developer's signature or checksum before installation, and it is not left in the Downloads folder after installation. Users can also set up scheduled checks, view updates via notifications or the menu bar, stop ongoing updates, and filter for apps that only support Intel or are no longer maintained.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.55
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Snaggy 1.10
item.description:
Cross-browser bookmarking tool for macOS

Snaggy is a native bookmark management and read-later tool for macOS. It allows you to save the current web page from different browsers using a unified shortcut key, consolidating scattered links into a single library. The default shortcut key is ⌘D. It only takes over the bookmarking operation when the browser is in the foreground, and you can also change it yourself. The software supports importing browser bookmarks, pinned tabs, and HTML bookmark files, preserving the original folder structure for easy migration of existing favorites. On eligible Macs, it uses Apple's on-device model to automatically create folders and organize links; when the requirements are not met, it categorizes them by website. The built-in reader supports blocking ads and trackers, offers a reading mode for articles, automatically marks articles as read upon reaching the end, and can open web pages in the browser used when the link was saved. Users can search their favorites from the menu bar and use local MCP services to enable AI tools like Claude, Codex, and Cursor to search for and save links. The database is stored locally, and no account creation is required. You can choose to use your personal iCloud to sync across multiple Macs, and it supports exporting to JSON, CSV, and HTML.

item.title: Squash 4.0.1
item.description:
Powerful batch photo editing tools

Squash 3 is a powerful batch photo editor designed for macOS, requiring Big Sur or later and compatible with macOS Sequoia, Intel, and Apple Silicon. The software not only enables fast batch conversion and image resizing, but also allows you to apply layered watermarks and filters, rename files, delete or edit private metadata, and more. Squash 3 is a native macOS app developed using Swift and SwiftUI. It delivers an excellent user experience and performs well on both Apple Silicon and older Intel Macs. Users can easily drag and drop multiple images into the app to compress their formats or convert HEIC photos to the standard JPG format for compatibility with other applications or internet services. Squash supports a variety of image adjustment features, including applying filters, compressing, modifying metadata, etc., and allows users to save custom presets for quick reuse of common settings. The software is highly praised by users for its outstanding compression capabilities and is an essential tool for every Mac user.

item.title: Fluent 2.3.11
item.description:
Flexible AI Writing Tool

Fluent is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve users' writing efficiency and quality. As flexible as Spotlight, it can operate in any application, helping users with a variety of tasks such as translation, grammar correction, drafting emails and social media posts, and extracting key points. Fluent supports users in using their own cloud AI API keys (such as OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenRouter) and offers over 320 OpenRouter models, as well as various local AI models that can be loaded directly from a Mac, ensuring data security. Users can customize hotkeys and actions, use over 30 preset default actions, and preview results in real time through the smart panel, including Markdown rendering. Fluent is a tool designed to enhance writing productivity. It prioritizes privacy, does not collect user data, and supports fully offline work. Fluent Mac is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve your writing efficiency and quality. It offers a wide range of features, including translation, grammar correction, and drafting of emails and social media posts, and can seamlessly integrate with any application you are using.

item.title: Peekaboo 0.1.24
item.description:
Mac Natural Language File Search

Peekaboo is a file management and disk space organization tool for macOS. It works with Finder, retaining common features such as tabs, column views, path bars, and file tags, and groups files by type, including images, videos, documents, and applications. The software supports natural language search and can convert file type, date, size, source, and folder criteria into editable filter options. It can also recognize text in screenshots, photos, and PDFs and categorize files by download source. Space Map presents disk usage in an interactive space map, combining the detection of duplicate files, similar photos, old downloads, and unused apps to help identify space that can be freed up. Regular cleanup moves items to the Trash and allows undoing actions one by one through the activity log. Built-in batch renaming, automatic folder organization, cloud storage directory integration, and 105 file and system tools, covering tasks such as PDF processing, audio and video conversion, transcription, and translation. Mac Health provides the status of the processor, memory, disk, network, and battery, along with a week's history.

item.title: Floodtide 1.6.3
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.

item.title: Tokens 4 Breakfast 2.1.1
item.description:
Menu bar Token usage monitoring

Tokens 4 Breakfast is a macOS menu bar application for developers and heavy users of AI tools. It is used to track the token usage, API consumption, subscription items, and rate limiting pressures of platforms such as Claude Code, Claude Web, OpenAI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, and OpenRouter. It aggregates AI spending scattered across web pages, dashboards, and billing pages into a permanent menu bar view that shows, in real time, current month spending, seven-day trends, thirty-day forecasts, session budgets, and upcoming quota risks. The application adopts the local priority design, does not need to log in to the account, does not rely on cloud services, does not track, the data is saved in the Mac native SQLite database, and can work offline; Claude Code automatically connects with GitHub Copilot to read local configuration or session files, and other platforms access via API Key.

item.title: ArcZip 1.2.6
item.description: quick management of compressed macOS files

item.title: EdgeBar 1.13
item.description:
macOS Trackpad Edge Controls Brightness Volume

EdgeBar is a menu bar tool for macOS that turns the edges of your MacBook trackpad into volume, screen brightness, and media playback controls. By default, the volume is adjusted by swiping along the right edge, the brightness is adjusted by swiping along the left edge, and the system prompts that are consistent with the keyboard adjustment are displayed; the left and right functions can be swapped as usual. Double-click the top right corner to quickly mute, the bottom media bar supports swiping to cut songs and double-click to play or pause, and you can reverse the direction of the cut song gesture. Provides slight tactile feedback when swiping, supports quarter step adjustment while holding down Shift and Option, and enables fine swiping without the need for a key. The software allows you to adjust the width of the edge, limit the sliding start area to three-quarters, one-half, or one-quarter below the edge, and configure the modifier key requirements to freeze with the cursor to reduce false touches in daily operations. The menu bar panel displays brightness and volume in real time, provides tactile intensity, light and dark appearance, login activation and automatic update settings, and optionally supports Magic Mouse top edge sliding.

item.title: MacMix Studio 2.3.8
item.description:
Mac App Standalone Volume Control

MacMix is a lightweight macOS menu bar audio mixing tool that uses the native SwiftUI interface to centralize system volume, app independent volume, output device switching, and microphone management in a compact panel that can be adjusted without opening system settings. The software can individually turn down the vocalizing application and enable a volume boost of up to 200% on demand, automatically remembering the volume of each application and resume at the next playback. For external monitors that support DDC/CI, the speaker volume can be directly controlled, and the slider can be muted when it drops to zero; at the same time, the AirPods, speakers, and AirPlay receiving devices can be switched, and the microphone input volume can be adjusted. Audio is processed locally on your Mac in real time and is not recorded, saved, uploaded, or required to register for an account. The core functions are open source under the mit license, and the Studio extension in the distribution provides functions such as application equalizer, multi-device output, scene preset, microphone lock, and theme customization.
